# LPKR.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp103.0 against Rp45.0 (expected total return 129.5%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: property_nav_discount_narrowing · method card: per fund record routing for Property developers.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- FY2026E parent NPAT is Rp691.5bn while 9M26 actual is Rp1,240bn, so the base case embeds an undisclosed, unsourced Q4-2026 net loss of Rp548.5bn. It is produced by other_nonop of Rp700bn, which the assumptions say is cal
- The P/E leg uses 14.26x, which is MKPI, the median of 31 P/Es from an 81-name screen that includes micro-caps at 26x-84x. Comparable township developers trade at 3.9x-7.0x (CTRA 3.92, BSDE 4.83, APLN 4.81, ASRI 4.59, PWO
- The P/BV leg applies 0.3135x, a four-observation mean, to post-deconsolidation book equity of Rp30,978bn. That multiple was earned when book equity was roughly half its size; section 4 rejects the same pre-2024 P/B histo

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
